verdict.rationale: Bruno's own CLI runs whole API collections from the command line, including in Docker and CI/CD pipelines. It generates test reports in JSON, JUnit and HTML formats, and the docs describe writing assertions and test suites. Missing for 10: detailed docs on pass/fail exit codes and per-request result breakdown, and independent or hands-on corroboration of collection runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an entire collection as an automated test suite with a pass/fail report

citations.quote: With Bruno CLI, you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands.
Generate Test Reports : Easily create reports in multiple formats, including JSON, JUnit, and HTML, to analyze and share test results.
Write assertions and test suites, and automate runs with data-driven testing.
CI/CD Integration: Effortlessly integrate with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and validation.
